verdict.tagline: Smooth performance meets brutal cooperative horror and steep climbs.
for_you_if: you thrive in punishing cooperative environments
you enjoy spatial proximity voice chat
not_for_you_if: you rely on robust controller support
you suffer from motion sickness on specific maps

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Players encounter poor controller support immediately.

citations.review_text: Its fun.  My friend likes to play it.  I gave it a try and it just was hard to play on controller and it crashed a couple times.  But it was fun to play.  Idk, maybe I'll give it another try.  I just don't know if its a game I'd keep or return to.  Especially on my own.

HORRIBLE controller support. First of all, the game doesn't even allow you to get a feel for the environment before introducing monsters and wacky game mechanics. The voice capture thing doesn't work properly. And I know I've mentioned this already, but my GOD, the controller support is a genuine joke. It's such a shame, because it seems like it has the potential to be a really fun party game, but alas. 0/10

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the game lacks meta-progression, meaning starting a new run resets all progress completely.

citations.review_text: The game is way to difficult from the start. There is no meta progression that help you with the start of a new run, with out some sort of progression after each reset it feel like wasted time and it's not fun to start over with nothing gained. Even if you try to hide most of the enemies can still get you and you can't run because 40 sprint isn't enough. The rotation mechanics feel too clunky and unresponsive for an event that requires you to stack items, especially when a lot of the items aren't made to be stacked. The monster spawns feel a little too ridiculous with the types of monsters you get especially for when starting over on fresh runs.

Wayyyyy too difficult. I bought this for me and my friend to play because it seemed fun, but its way too hard. There is 0 balancing period.

There is no balancing difficulty for how early you are in the game, there's no balancing difficulty for upgrades, there's no balancing for amount of people in the game, there's no balancing for map size.

Weapons are expensive and single use only, upgrades give you marginal boosts and are only for individual players. Some monsters are essentially unkillable, especially early on. 

We haven't made it past level 3. Because its really luck of the draw with the monsters. The monsters can come inside your truck, some will destroy all of your loot so you have to restart anyways, and some maps just spawn too many monsters.

Other than the balancing the game is very fun. I have PoTs and the horror aspect doesn't kickstart my heart too badly. The looting and exploration aspect is fun, as well as the voice chat. Its unfortunate but the game is practically unplayable if you want to make any actual progress without restarting over and over.

Thats right, because if you die you don't restart the level. You restart the WHOLE GAME. Repo is a game I really want to like, but the devs need to focus on balancing and creating progression instead of adding new, practically invincible monsters that show up on level 1 (where its impossible to have weapons.)

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the early game as exceptionally difficult, featuring limited stamina and aggressive, punishing monsters encountered right at the start.

citations.review_text: The game is way to difficult from the start. There is no meta progression that help you with the start of a new run, with out some sort of progression after each reset it feel like wasted time and it's not fun to start over with nothing gained. Even if you try to hide most of the enemies can still get you and you can't run because 40 sprint isn't enough. The rotation mechanics feel too clunky and unresponsive for an event that requires you to stack items, especially when a lot of the items aren't made to be stacked. The monster spawns feel a little too ridiculous with the types of monsters you get especially for when starting over on fresh runs.

This game has some really fun concepts but in my opinion most things aren't designed to be fun. The start of a run is really slow because you're SO weak, but even then the monsters are SO punishing. Yes, you can get upgrades which does help a lot but you actually have to get far enough to get those upgrades. At the start of a run you can sprint for about 2-3 seconds before you run out of stamina, but all the monsters just keep sprinting full sped at you and now you cant do anything about it. Some of the monsters just insta-kill you or just have 0 way to beat them in early runs. 
Now you could say that's all just a skill issue so I played a solo run and was extra cautious to see if getting further made the game better. Well I only got to level 3 when the game decided it was over because I got soft locked by not being able to meet quota. The only item left on the map was too heavy to pick up even though I had bought every strength upgrade I could. LEVEL 3... that's the best it could offer before I had to kill myself. Also half of the monsters 1 shot but death is just game over no matter what. Anyway enough rambling this game is just badly designed - Make enemies less punishing, Stop putting the heaviest loot in the first couple levels when no one can even move them an inch, And maybe make the game less of a slog for the first few levels.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features proximity voice chat, allowing player audio to be heard spatially.

citations.review_text: Love the game actually, it is so fun to play with friends the proximity voice chat is so fun. I would recommend to play it with people, but you can play with randoms I you don't have friends who want to play R.E.P.O. with you. I would recommend!
Hilarious game to play with a group. I like the feature where sounds from one another drift according to proximity.

Definitely reccomend this game. It is great fun with friends. No grinding no unfair advantages. You just start the game and play. You laugh a lot and in game voice chat is a must and is really great. Spatial audio works wonders and makes it immersive.

9/10 One of the most fun I've had playing a game. The different levels are unique and spooky, and the threats are well made and can catch you off guard. Recommend playing with friends though. The proximity chat is my favorite part, and I like the way you can talk to teammates when dead. Altogether very enjoyable!

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players navigate steep upgrade costs and map-specific motion sickness.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the price of upgrades increases rapidly and request a cap or pricing adjustment per shop rotation.

citations.review_text:
This game is fantastic! The devs are great and add lots of content quite frequently.
The enemy designs are unique and the unique item effects add a lot of fun moments.

There are some minor problems I have with the game:

One of the problems I have is that there are lots of enemies that break or damage items without any good way to counteract it besides killing them. (The Indestructable Drone only works on one item)
Having a drone or upgrade for the cart that would use energy to make the items inside immune to enemy damage would be great.

The other problem is that the amount of money needed for upgrades quickly becomes insanely high. It would help if there was a cap and the price increase happens per upgrade instead of per shop rotation. (So we don't need to wait until the optimal amount of a specific upgrade is present)

Aside from those two gripes, I would highly recommend playing this game. The price is great for the amount of play value that you get.
The game is a lot of fun, but i feel like it's one BIG troll. the money VS upgrades and tools just don't seem to cut it. especially when you have a small group. good game,

claims.claim: Reviewers describe experiencing motion sickness or nausea when playing on specific maps.

citations.review_text: THE game to have a blast with with friends, despite the slight motion sickness and my dumb blind self cannot see jack.

One of the best games to play with friends. Ofc it is fun solo too as you can refresh the store as much as you want by going back to the main menu. Finally writing the review bcz as of the latest update with one new map, I HATE it. None of us, me and my friends, can stand playing that map for more than 5 mins. It made us nauseated and couldn't play anymore after just one round of that map. I think it is the yellow lighting that make us like that. But anyway we just refresh every time we got that map to avoid it. I used to have really good ping for the hosting but after the update my usual server is now at 800ms and I can't join anyone's lobby anymore either. Never have that problem before so I am just playing solo more until it is fixed. Still would give the game 8/10.

single_points.text: One reviewer suggests proximity chat for an enhanced experience because the monsters can hear you.

citation.review_text:
It`s a fun exstraction game, best played with friend(s).
Fun mechanics, som frustartions but it`s part of the gameplay, suggest proximity chat over something like voice chat programs for a enhanced experience, the monsters can hear you, there is a bit of a learning curve and with cosmetics introduced there is something to chase.
Collect, exstract, leave, buy, repeat.
Repedetive but strangly addicting, mess around, do tasks and have weird situations and conversations while monsters tries to stop you from doing you job.
It might take a little time for it to click, but the monsters do have tricks to deal with them, and you might struggle a little, but you`ll learn, some are blind, some dont want to be looked at.
Good luck!, may the loot be plentyful!.
